001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class SDDInsurgentACAFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
014        
015        public SDDInsurgentACAFactor() {
016        }
017
018        @Override
019        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
020                return true;
021        }
022        
023        @Override
024        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
025                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
026                        @Override
027                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
028                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
029                                tooltip.addPara("The Nortia-based Askonia Charterist Alliance (ACA) is participating in the United Front uprising, carrying out a campaign of"
030                                                + " subversion, sabotage, and raids against official Sindrian Diktat forces.", 0f, h, "Askonia Charterist Alliance");
031                                
032                                // if well supplied ... 
033                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerHelpedACAfinished")) {
034                                        tooltip.addPara("Through Arnaud Iscare you have provided the ACA with credits, fuel,"
035                                                        + " and supplies which greatly increases their effectiveness.", 8f, h, "Arnaud Iscare");
036                                }
037                                
038                                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) {
039                                        tooltip.addPara("The ACA is receiving additional materiel from Arroyo's smuggling operation.", 8f, h, "Arroyo");
040                                }
041                                
042                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_uploadedAskoniaCommsHackInesis") &&
043                                        (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForAntiMacario") || 
044                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForHectorNoMac"))) {
045                                        tooltip.addPara("Sindrian Diktat Absolutist forces have suffered from a series of inexplicable "
046                                                        + "intelligence failures in their attempts to deal with the ACA rebels.", 8f, h, "inexplicable");
047                                }
048                                
049                                // TODO: and if someone invades Nortia..
050                                //tooltip.addPara("The ACA base of operations on Nortia has been invaded and destroyed by" 
051                                //+ " Sindrian Diktat forces, greatly hindering their effectiveness.", 8f, h, "Nortia");
052                        }
053                };
054        }
055
056        @Override
057        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
058//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
059                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
060        }
061        
062        @Override
063        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
064                int _multiplier = 0;
065                
066                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveFuelACA")) _multiplier++;
067                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveCreditsACA")) _multiplier++;
068                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveSuppliesACA")) _multiplier++;
069                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerHelpedACAfinished")) _multiplier++;
070                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) _multiplier++;
071                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksHegemony")) _multiplier++;
072                
073                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_uploadedAskoniaCommsHackInesis") &&
074                        (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForAntiMacario") || 
075                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForHectorNoMac"))) {
076                        _multiplier++;
077                }
078                
079                //if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_uploadedAskoniaCommsHackInesis")) _multiplier++;
080                        
081                return SDDPoints.ACA_BASE + SDDPoints.ACA_EFFECT * _multiplier;
082        }
083
084        @Override
085        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
086                return "ACA raiding";
087        }
088        
089        @Override
090        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
091                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
092                return Misc.getGrayColor();
093        }
094
095        
096}
